context.story_title: User Can Edit an Existing Course
context.section_tech_spec_epic_2_relevance: The core of this story directly addresses Acceptance Criteria 5 from `tech-spec-epic-2.md`: "The user can edit the title and syllabus of an existing course." The implementation should leverage the `updateCourse` method defined in the `ICourseManager` interface.
context.section_architecture_relevance: As per `solution-architecture.md`, the Next.js frontend will communicate directly with Supabase via `supabase-js`. All database operations for courses are protected by Row Level Security (RLS) policies to ensure users can only modify their own courses. The `FastAPI Backend` is not involved in simple CRUD operations for courses.

code_snippets.sql_table_definition: CREATE TABLE public.courses ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, syllabus TEXT, -- This column was added in story-2-001 or is assumed based on requirements exam_date DATE, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, -- For soft delete created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() );

sql_rls_policy.name: Enable all access for own courses

code_snippets.sql_rls_policy: CREATE POLICY "Enable all access for own courses" ON public.courses FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

context.ui_ux_considerations: The UI for editing a course should: - Be accessible from a course listing or detail view (e.g., via an "Edit" button). - Present a form or modal pre-filled with the current course name and syllabus. - Include clear labels and input fields for both "Course Name" and "Syllabus Content". - Provide "Save" and "Cancel" buttons. - Display appropriate feedback to the user on success or failure of the update operation. - Handle form validation (e.g., ensuring the course name is not empty).
context.developer_notes: - Ensure that the client-side `CourseManager` properly wraps the `supabase-js` `update` call for the `courses` table. - Remember to include the `syllabus` column in the `UPDATE` statement, even though it's not explicitly in the initial `CREATE TABLE` script of `solution-architecture.md`, it is implied by `story-2-001` and the tech spec's ACs. - Thoroughly test RLS: attempt to update a course belonging to another user (should fail) and a course belonging to the current user (should succeed).
